p.scope-of-this-document: **Scope of this document.** The procedure for adding a new operating mode to a project's catalogue: how to take a posture the owner keeps describing informally and turn it into a catalogued codeword that is unambiguous, safe, and recognised the same way every time.

when.title: When a new codeword is warranted

p.WRITE-ONE-WHEN-THE-ASKING-ITSELF-HAS-BEC: Write one when the owner **repeatedly** asks for the same non-default posture — and the asking itself has become overhead. Signs:

facts.SIGN-THE-OWNER-KEEPS-RE-EXPLAINING-THE-S: The owner keeps re-explaining the same working style ("just push through, don't check with me on each step").
facts.SIGN-THE-AGENT-KEEPS-MIS-CALIBRATING: The agent keeps mis-calibrating because the posture was implicit.
facts.SIGN-A-RECOGNISABLE-PHRASE-IS-ALREADY-EM: A recognisable phrase is already emerging in how the owner asks.

p.ONE-OFF-REQUESTS-DO-NOT-NEED-A-CODEWORD: One-off requests do not need a codeword.

p.A-CODEWORD-IS-FOR-A-POSTURE-WORTH-NAMING: A codeword is for a posture worth naming because it recurs.

step-name.title: 1. Name the posture and the trigger

p.PICK-THE-TRIGGER-FROM-HOW-THE-OWNER-ALRE: Pick the trigger phrase from how the owner already speaks.

p.CASE-INSENSITIVE-AND-MATCHED-BY-INTENT: Case-insensitive, matched by intent — the agent recognises the meaning, not a literal string.

p.CAPTURE-THE-OWNERS-OWN-FRAMING-IN-THEIR-: Capture the owner's own framing of what the mode is for, in their words, dated.

p.THE-DESCRIPTION-IS-THE-AUTHORISATION: This is part 2 of the five-part shape and it is load-bearing: the description *is* the authorisation, so a paraphrase would be a different authorisation.

p.DO-NOT-TIDY-THE-DESCRIPTION-INTO-YOUR-OW: Do not tidy it into your own prose.

p.TRANSLATE-THE-DESCRIPTION-INTO-A-NUMBERE: Translate the description into a numbered list of concrete behaviours the agent follows while the mode is active.

p.EACH-RULE-IS-TESTABLE-BY-THE-AGENT-ITSEL: Each rule is testable in the sense that the agent can tell whether it is obeying it.

p.vague-rules-are-useless-specific-ones-ar: Vague rules ("be thorough") are useless; specific ones ("each phase lands with green tests before the next begins") are the whole value.

step-limits.title: 4. State changes and non-changes — restate the red lines

facts.STATE-WHAT-CONFIRMATION-BEHAVIOUR-THE-MO: **what confirmation behaviour the mode relaxes** (almost always: the routine-work handshake), and
facts.STATE-THAT-THE-RED-LINES-SURVIVE-IT: **that the red lines survive it** — reproduce the project's red-line list here, do not merely reference it. The restatement is deliberate friction: a mode whose author had to re-type the red lines is a mode whose author confirmed the mode respects them.

p.A-MODE-THAT-WOULD-RELAX-A-RED-LINE-IS-MA: A proposed mode that would relax a red line is malformed.

p.DO-NOT-CATALOGUE-IT-TELL-THE-OWNER-WHY: Do not catalogue it; tell the owner why.

p.SPECIFY-ACTIVATION-PERSISTENCE-ABORTS-AN: Specify activation scope, persistence within a session, non- persistence across sessions, the abort signals (owner-side and agent-side), and the reporting cadence (status, not requests).

p.MODES-DEFAULT-TO-NOT-CROSSING-A-SESSION-: Modes default to *not* crossing a session boundary; say so explicitly.

p.ADD-THE-MODE-TO-THE-CATALOGUE-AND-NOTE-I: Add the mode to the project's operating-modes document and, if the project loads a boot file, note its existence there so a fresh session recognises the trigger.

p.AN-UNCATALOGUED-PHRASE-IS-A-PROPOSAL: Until it is catalogued, the phrase is a proposal and the agent does not act on it.

p.MODES-CAN-COMBINE-WHEN-IT-MAKES-SENSE: Modes can combine when it makes sense — "wrap up + move fast" runs a finish-up phase at accelerated cadence.

p.COMPOSITION-NEVER-SUMS-RELAXATIONS-PAST-: Composition never sums the relaxations past the red lines: two modes together still cannot waive an irreversible-threshold handshake.

p.WHEN-IN-DOUBT-THE-STRICTER-POSTURE-WINS: When in doubt about a combination, treat the stricter posture as winning.

td.ROW-SMELL-NO-VERBATIM-DESCRIPTION: A codeword with no verbatim description

td.fact: the authorisation is the agent's paraphrase, not the owner's intent
the default posture is already careful; a mode *relaxes*, it does not re-assert the default
drop it; the default covers it

td.ROW-SMELL-NO-RED-LINES-LISTED: A mode that lists no red lines

td.fact: restate the full list in part 4

td.ROW-SMELL-ACTED-ON-BEFORE-CATALOGUING: A phrase acted on before cataloguing

td.ROW-SMELL-SILENT-CROSS-SESSION-PERSISTEN: A mode that persists across sessions silently

td.fact: a later session inherits a posture nobody re-authorised

facts.SUM-WRITE-A-CODEWORD-WHEN-ASKING-IS-ITSE: Write a codeword when a non-default posture recurs enough that asking for it is itself overhead.
facts.SUM-THE-TWO-NON-NEGOTIABLE-PARTS: Follow the six steps; the verbatim description and the restated red lines are the two non-negotiable parts.
facts.SUM-A-MODE-NEVER-TOUCHES-A-RED-LINE: A mode relaxes confirmation behaviour only; it never touches a red line, alone or composed.
facts.SUM-CATALOGUE-BEFORE-ACTING: Catalogue before acting — an uncatalogued phrase is a proposal, not a mode.
